title: 磁浮列車軌道梁精度控制~Guideway precision control for maglev
focus: 以空間頻譜與測量不確定度控制磁浮導梁精度~Maglev guideway precision through spatial spectra and survey uncertainty
summary: 本課聚焦以空間頻譜與測量不確定度控制磁浮導梁精度。從導向道測量角度誤差建立物理或資訊邊界，接著把不平順波長轉換與理想吸力模型的適用邊界連成可驗證的介面，最後以有限合格紀錄的外推整理證據。學徒逐一完成機制推導、數值算例、失效辨識及參數實驗，所有練習限定在離線模型或隔離教具，保留假設與量測的不確定度。~This course studies maglev guideway precision through spatial spectra and survey uncertainty. Start with angular error in guideway surveying to define physical or information boundaries, connect converting irregularity wavelengths with limits of an ideal magnetic-attraction model as verifiable interfaces, and organize evidence through extrapolating finite successful records. Each unit develops a mechanism, numerical example, failure diagnosis and parameter experiment in an offline model or isolated teaching rig, retaining assumptions and measurement uncertainty.
history: 本課以可查核的工程與方法出版歷程建立背景：1994 年磁浮導梁施工精度與乘坐研究出版。；1998 年梁式磁浮導向道施工精度研究出版。；2025 年鐵路可靠度與安全方法第一分冊發布。這些日期分別是工程事件、指南重印或標準研究出版，並非宣稱本課系統在該年問世。對以空間頻譜與測量不確定度控制磁浮導梁精度而言，歷史脈絡的價值是理解需求如何從單一設備擴展到跨介面證據。本課再用精度帳的獨立與相關成分及測量施工與運行邊界連結這些方法；代表工程僅提供觀察方向，假想參數不冒充現場資料，歷史版規範也不自動等於當地現行要求。~The background uses checkable project events and methodological publication history. 1994: Research linking maglev guideway precision and ride was published. 1998: Research on beam-type maglev guideway construction accuracy was published. 2025: A new first part of railway RAMS was published. These dates identify project events, guide reprints, or standards and research publications, rather than claiming that the lesson system first appeared then. For maglev guideway precision through spatial spectra and survey uncertainty, the useful historical perspective is the expansion from individual equipment to evidence across interfaces. The course connects that perspective through independent and correlated precision terms and survey, construction and running cases. Reference projects guide observation only: hypothetical parameters are not field data, and historical editions do not automatically establish current local requirements.
example: 原創整合工作單，所有輸入均為教學假設而非代表工程實測：先研究導向道測量角度誤差。原創假想教學輸入：視線距離 distance=40 m；小角誤差 angle=2.5e-05 rad。公式 y=distance*angle*1000，代入得 y=1 mm。邊界：小角近似與單一方向誤差，未含完整測量網平差。敏感度只改 distance=40 至 44 m，輸出變為 1.1 mm；離散計數採整數變化。再獨立研究精度帳的獨立與相關成分：原創假想教學輸入：獨立誤差一標準差 s1=3 mm；獨立誤差二標準差 s2=4 mm。公式 y=sqrt(s1*s1+s2*s2)，代入得 y=5 mm。邊界：獨立隨機標準差，不代表確定的最大偏移界。兩個結果不能因同一課程就任意相加，必須先確認單位、因果順序及共同邊界。先由視距與微小角度誤差估算橫向偏移，辨認長視線對控制網的影響。再用獨立站點和閉合差交叉檢查，避免共同基準錯誤被重複性掩蓋。最後提出一項量測能區分模型假設失效與儀器偏差，將輸入表、重算結果和適用限制一併交付。~Original integrated worksheet; every input is a teaching assumption rather than a measurement from a reference project. First investigate angular error in guideway surveying. Original hypothetical teaching inputs: sight distance distance=40 m; small angular error angle=2.5e-05 rad. Formula y=distance*angle*1000 gives y=1 mm. Boundary: Small-angle approximation for one direction error, not a complete survey-network adjustment. For sensitivity, change only distance=40 to 44 m; the output becomes 1.1 mm. Discrete counts use whole-number steps. Independently investigate independent and correlated precision terms: Original hypothetical teaching inputs: first independent standard deviation s1=3 mm; second independent standard deviation s2=4 mm. Formula y=sqrt(s1*s1+s2*s2) gives y=5 mm. Boundary: Independent random standard deviations, not a deterministic maximum displacement bound. Results cannot be added merely because they belong to the same course: check units, causal sequence and shared boundaries first. Estimate transverse offset from sight distance and small angular error to examine network sensitivity. Cross-check independent stations and closure so repeatability cannot hide a shared datum fault. Propose one measurement distinguishing a failed model assumption from instrument bias, and deliver the input table, recomputed results and applicability limits together.

units.anchor: 導向道測量角度誤差~Angular error in guideway surveying
units.title: 導向道測量角度誤差~Angular error in guideway surveying
units.mechanism: 先由視距與微小角度誤差估算橫向偏移，辨認長視線對控制網的影響。再用獨立站點和閉合差交叉檢查，避免共同基準錯誤被重複性掩蓋。小角度方向誤差會隨視線距離放大成橫向位置誤差，長視線不一定帶來更準的幾何控制。基準網、折光、儀器對中與目標安裝都會影響結果；同一站多次讀值一致，仍可能共同受到基準偏移影響。解釋前先固定模型適用範圍：小角近似與單一方向誤差，未含完整測量網平差。~Estimate transverse offset from sight distance and small angular error to examine network sensitivity. Cross-check independent stations and closure so repeatability cannot hide a shared datum fault. A small angular error becomes transverse position error proportional to sight distance, so a longer sight is not automatically more accurate. Control networks, refraction, centring and target mounting all matter. Repeated agreement from one station can still share a common datum error. Before interpreting the result, fix its domain: Small-angle approximation for one direction error, not a complete survey-network adjustment.
units.model: 原創假想教學輸入：視線距離 distance=40 m；小角誤差 angle=2.5e-05 rad。公式 y=distance*angle*1000，代入得 y=1 mm。邊界：小角近似與單一方向誤差，未含完整測量網平差。~Original hypothetical teaching inputs: sight distance distance=40 m; small angular error angle=2.5e-05 rad. Formula y=distance*angle*1000 gives y=1 mm. Boundary: Small-angle approximation for one direction error, not a complete survey-network adjustment.
units.verify: 用不同站位與往返觀測交叉核對，將角度誤差、對中誤差與基準移動分列。以「導向道測量角度誤差」為驗證目標，先寫出預期變化方向及可分辨的替代原因，再保存原始讀值、單位、校正版本與時間窗。只有比較同一系統邊界的資料，才判定殘差是否支持這項機制。~Cross-check from different stations and reciprocal observations, separating angular error, centring and datum movement. For angular error in guideway surveying, state the expected direction and distinguishable alternative causes before collecting data. Retain raw readings, units, calibration version and observation window. Compare evidence within the same system boundary before deciding whether the residual supports this mechanism.
units.failure: 儀器重複性良好可能掩蓋穩定的對中偏差，熱折光則使日夜結果有系統差異。回到「導向道測量角度誤差」的輸入鏈逐項定位；先重播單一異常，再比較共同原因的組合。保留不確定項，避免為了讓結果符合預期而刪去不利證據。~Good repeatability can conceal stable centring bias; thermal refraction can create systematic day-night differences. Trace the input chain for angular error in guideway surveying. Replay one anomaly first, then compare common-cause combinations. Retain uncertain observations rather than discarding adverse evidence to force the expected conclusion.
units.misconception: 同一站位重複量測完全一致就能保證絕對位置正確~Identical repeated observations from one station guarantee correct absolute position.
units.practice: 只把視線距離 distance 從 40 改成 44 m（增加百分之十），其餘輸入固定。重算結果應由 1 變為 1.1 mm。先說明「導向道測量角度誤差」中變化的因果方向，再檢查適用邊界是否仍成立，提交計算與一個可反駁此解釋的觀測。~Change only sight distance distance from 40 to 44 m (increase by ten percent), holding other inputs fixed. Recalculate 1 to 1.1 mm. Explain the causal direction for angular error in guideway surveying, check that the stated boundary still holds, and submit the calculation plus one observation that could refute the explanation.

units.anchor: 精度帳的獨立與相關成分~Independent and correlated precision terms
units.title: 精度帳的獨立與相關成分~Independent and correlated precision terms
units.mechanism: 把儀器重複誤差、目標安裝和基準偏移逐項分類，只有符合獨立假設者才合成標準差。共同偏移仍須另列，不能用漂亮的總數代替誤差來源說明。獨立零均值誤差的變異數可以相加，因此標準差以平方和開根號合成。這個做法不適合直接合併最大容差或共同偏差；一旦共享基準造成相關性，協方差項就必須回到計算中，不能繼續假裝量測彼此獨立。解釋前先固定模型適用範圍：獨立隨機標準差，不代表確定的最大偏移界。~Classify repeat-reading error, target installation and datum offsets before combining independent standard deviations. Keep common shifts explicit instead of replacing the error story with an attractive total. Variances of independent zero-mean errors add, giving a root-sum-square standard deviation. This is not a way to combine maximum tolerances or common bias. When a shared datum creates correlation, covariance terms belong in the calculation rather than assuming continued independence. Before interpreting the result, fix its domain: Independent random standard deviations, not a deterministic maximum displacement bound.
units.model: 原創假想教學輸入：獨立誤差一標準差 s1=3 mm；獨立誤差二標準差 s2=4 mm。公式 y=sqrt(s1*s1+s2*s2)，代入得 y=5 mm。邊界：獨立隨機標準差，不代表確定的最大偏移界。~Original hypothetical teaching inputs: first independent standard deviation s1=3 mm; second independent standard deviation s2=4 mm. Formula y=sqrt(s1*s1+s2*s2) gives y=5 mm. Boundary: Independent random standard deviations, not a deterministic maximum displacement bound.
units.verify: 以重複量測估計標準差與相關係數，將固定偏差另列，再核對合成殘差。以「精度帳的獨立與相關成分」為驗證目標，先寫出預期變化方向及可分辨的替代原因，再保存原始讀值、單位、校正版本與時間窗。只有比較同一系統邊界的資料，才判定殘差是否支持這項機制。~Estimate standard deviations and correlation from repeated observations, separate fixed bias, and compare combined residuals. For independent and correlated precision terms, state the expected direction and distinguishable alternative causes before collecting data. Retain raw readings, units, calibration version and observation window. Compare evidence within the same system boundary before deciding whether the residual supports this mechanism.
units.failure: 共同基準誤差會使所有讀值同向偏移，重複次數增加也無法把這種偏差平均掉。回到「精度帳的獨立與相關成分」的輸入鏈逐項定位；先重播單一異常，再比較共同原因的組合。保留不確定項，避免為了讓結果符合預期而刪去不利證據。~A common datum error shifts readings together, and additional repetition cannot average away that shared bias. Trace the input chain for independent and correlated precision terms. Replay one anomaly first, then compare common-cause combinations. Retain uncertain observations rather than discarding adverse evidence to force the expected conclusion.
units.misconception: 任何兩個誤差都可以不問相關性直接平方和開根號~Any two errors can be combined by root-sum-square without considering correlation.
units.practice: 只把獨立誤差一標準差 s1 從 3 改成 3.3 mm（增加百分之十），其餘輸入固定。重算結果應由 5 變為 5.18556 mm。先說明「精度帳的獨立與相關成分」中變化的因果方向，再檢查適用邊界是否仍成立，提交計算與一個可反駁此解釋的觀測。~Change only first independent standard deviation s1 from 3 to 3.3 mm (increase by ten percent), holding other inputs fixed. Recalculate 5 to 5.18556 mm. Explain the causal direction for independent and correlated precision terms, check that the stated boundary still holds, and submit the calculation plus one observation that could refute the explanation.

units.anchor: 導梁溫差與基準時刻~Guideway temperature and reference epoch
units.title: 導梁溫差與基準時刻~Guideway temperature and reference epoch
units.mechanism: 不同時間量測的導梁可能因溫度而改變長度，先定義比較所用的參考狀態。自由均勻伸長只是基準模型，熱梯度和拘束須另外追蹤。自由熱伸長與原長、膨脹係數及溫差成正比，但受拘束後伸長會被轉成內力。接縫、支承與鄰接構件共同決定這種轉換；因此同一個溫差可能在自由端表現為位移，在固定端表現為應力，不能用一種量測代替另一種。解釋前先固定模型適用範圍：均勻溫度與自由伸長；不包含熱梯度引起的彎曲。~Measurements at different times may capture thermal length changes, so define the comparison reference state first. Uniform free expansion is only a baseline; gradients and restraint require separate tracking. Free thermal expansion scales with length, coefficient and temperature change, while restraint converts some expansion into force. Joints, supports and adjoining members govern that conversion. The same temperature change can produce movement at a free end and stress at a restrained end, so one measurement cannot replace the other. Before interpreting the result, fix its domain: Uniform temperature and free expansion; thermal-gradient bending is omitted.
units.model: 原創假想教學輸入：構件長度 L=30 m；膨脹係數 alpha=1.2e-05 1/K；溫度變化 dT=20 K。公式 y=L*alpha*dT*1000，代入得 y=7.2 mm。邊界：均勻溫度與自由伸長；不包含熱梯度引起的彎曲。~Original hypothetical teaching inputs: member length L=30 m; expansion coefficient alpha=1.2e-05 1/K; temperature change dT=20 K. Formula y=L*alpha*dT*1000 gives y=7.2 mm. Boundary: Uniform temperature and free expansion; thermal-gradient bending is omitted.
units.verify: 以多點溫度檢查均勻假設，再對照端點位移與支承狀態，分辨自由與拘束行為。以「導梁溫差與基準時刻」為驗證目標，先寫出預期變化方向及可分辨的替代原因，再保存原始讀值、單位、校正版本與時間窗。只有比較同一系統邊界的資料，才判定殘差是否支持這項機制。~Check temperature uniformity at several points and compare end movement with support condition to distinguish free and restrained behaviour. For guideway temperature and reference epoch, state the expected direction and distinguishable alternative causes before collecting data. Retain raw readings, units, calibration version and observation window. Compare evidence within the same system boundary before deciding whether the residual supports this mechanism.
units.failure: 支承卡住可能讓位移很小但內力增加，日照溫差又可能造成彎曲而非單純伸長。回到「導梁溫差與基準時刻」的輸入鏈逐項定位；先重播單一異常，再比較共同原因的組合。保留不確定項，避免為了讓結果符合預期而刪去不利證據。~A seized support can suppress movement while increasing force; solar gradients may cause bending rather than simple extension. Trace the input chain for guideway temperature and reference epoch. Replay one anomaly first, then compare common-cause combinations. Retain uncertain observations rather than discarding adverse evidence to force the expected conclusion.
units.misconception: 量不到熱伸長就表示構件完全沒有熱應力~No measured thermal expansion means that a member has no thermal stress.
units.practice: 只把構件長度 L 從 30 改成 33 m（增加百分之十），其餘輸入固定。重算結果應由 7.2 變為 7.92 mm。先說明「導梁溫差與基準時刻」中變化的因果方向，再檢查適用邊界是否仍成立，提交計算與一個可反駁此解釋的觀測。~Change only member length L from 30 to 33 m (increase by ten percent), holding other inputs fixed. Recalculate 7.2 to 7.92 mm. Explain the causal direction for guideway temperature and reference epoch, check that the stated boundary still holds, and submit the calculation plus one observation that could refute the explanation.

units.anchor: 不平順波長轉換~Converting irregularity wavelengths
units.title: 不平順波長轉換~Converting irregularity wavelengths
units.mechanism: 保留導向道不平順的波長，而不只報最大高低差，才能連到行車激振頻率。比較不同假想車速的頻率變化，明確區分幾何輸入和車體實際反應。固定空間波長在移動車輛上轉換成時間激振頻率，因此同一幾何不平順在不同速度下可能接近不同振動模態。只看最大偏差會漏掉波長資訊；導梁精度控制需要把幾何頻譜、車速與車輛動態連結，而非只追求單點誤差最小。解釋前先固定模型適用範圍：定速通過單一正弦空間成分，未計車輛傳遞函數。~Retain irregularity wavelength rather than only maximum deviation to relate geometry to excitation frequency. Compare hypothetical speeds while distinguishing geometric input from actual vehicle response. A spatial wavelength becomes a temporal excitation frequency on a moving vehicle, so the same geometry can excite different modes at different speeds. Maximum deviation alone loses wavelength information. Guideway precision therefore links geometry spectra, speed and vehicle dynamics rather than only minimizing point errors. Before interpreting the result, fix its domain: Constant-speed passage over one sinusoidal spatial component; the vehicle transfer function is not included.
units.model: 原創假想教學輸入：運行速度 speed=40 m/s；幾何波長 wavelength=20 m。公式 y=speed/wavelength，代入得 y=2 Hz。邊界：定速通過單一正弦空間成分，未計車輛傳遞函數。~Original hypothetical teaching inputs: running speed speed=40 m/s; geometric wavelength wavelength=20 m. Formula y=speed/wavelength gives y=2 Hz. Boundary: Constant-speed passage over one sinusoidal spatial component; the vehicle transfer function is not included.
units.verify: 將幾何資料按里程頻譜分析，再用速度轉換頻率，與車上加速度頻譜比較。以「不平順波長轉換」為驗證目標，先寫出預期變化方向及可分辨的替代原因，再保存原始讀值、單位、校正版本與時間窗。只有比較同一系統邊界的資料，才判定殘差是否支持這項機制。~Analyse geometry by spatial frequency, transform using speed, and compare with onboard acceleration spectra. For converting irregularity wavelengths, state the expected direction and distinguishable alternative causes before collecting data. Retain raw readings, units, calibration version and observation window. Compare evidence within the same system boundary before deciding whether the residual supports this mechanism.
units.failure: 里程軸不均勻會扭曲頻譜，忽略車輛模態又可能把所有波長視為同樣重要。回到「不平順波長轉換」的輸入鏈逐項定位；先重播單一異常，再比較共同原因的組合。保留不確定項，避免為了讓結果符合預期而刪去不利證據。~Uneven distance sampling distorts spectra; ignoring vehicle modes incorrectly treats every wavelength as equally important. Trace the input chain for converting irregularity wavelengths. Replay one anomaly first, then compare common-cause combinations. Retain uncertain observations rather than discarding adverse evidence to force the expected conclusion.
units.misconception: 幾何最大誤差一樣時所有波長的乘坐影響一定一樣~Equal maximum geometry error gives identical ride effects at every wavelength.
units.practice: 只把運行速度 speed 從 40 改成 44 m/s（增加百分之十），其餘輸入固定。重算結果應由 2 變為 2.2 Hz。先說明「不平順波長轉換」中變化的因果方向，再檢查適用邊界是否仍成立，提交計算與一個可反駁此解釋的觀測。~Change only running speed speed from 40 to 44 m/s (increase by ten percent), holding other inputs fixed. Recalculate 2 to 2.2 Hz. Explain the causal direction for converting irregularity wavelengths, check that the stated boundary still holds, and submit the calculation plus one observation that could refute the explanation.

units.anchor: 懸浮系統頻率量級~Frequency scale of a suspension model
units.title: 懸浮系統頻率量級~Frequency scale of a suspension model
units.mechanism: 用線性單自由度彈簧質量模型理解固有頻率，並清楚標示它沒有完整磁路與控制器。再比較幾何激振的頻率位置，不由無阻尼模型推論真實乘坐加速度。單自由度固有頻率由剛度與質量比的平方根決定。提高剛度可能移開一個激振頻率，也可能移近另一個頻率；阻尼控制峰值而不只改變頻率，因此僅比較靜態變形不能預測動態放大。解釋前先固定模型適用範圍：線性無阻尼單自由度頻率，未含多模態與輪軌或磁路耦合。~Use a linear spring-mass model to understand frequency scale while explicitly excluding full magnetic and controller dynamics. Compare excitation locations without inferring actual ride acceleration from an undamped model. A single-degree natural frequency follows the square root of stiffness-to-mass ratio. Stiffening can move away from one excitation yet toward another. Damping controls the resonant peak as well as frequency effects, so static deflection alone cannot predict dynamic amplification. Before interpreting the result, fix its domain: Linear undamped single-degree frequency without multimode, wheel-rail or magnetic coupling.
units.model: 原創假想教學輸入：等效剛度 k=1.8e+06 N/m；等效質量 m=12000 kg。公式 y=sqrt(k/m)/(2*pi)，代入得 y=1.94924 Hz。邊界：線性無阻尼單自由度頻率，未含多模態與輪軌或磁路耦合。~Original hypothetical teaching inputs: equivalent stiffness k=1.8e+06 N/m; equivalent mass m=12000 kg. Formula y=sqrt(k/m)/(2*pi) gives y=1.94924 Hz. Boundary: Linear undamped single-degree frequency without multimode, wheel-rail or magnetic coupling.

units.anchor: 幾何檢測速度與取樣~Inspection speed and geometric sampling
units.title: 幾何檢測速度與取樣~Inspection speed and geometric sampling
units.mechanism: 固定取樣頻率在較高檢測速度下會拉大空間間距，可能漏過短波長特徵。核對時間戳與抗混疊前提，不把資料點變多直接當成幾何證據變強。固定時間取樣在移動系統中對應空間間隔，速度越高相同頻率越容易漏過狹窄特徵。時間戳抖動會讓空間取樣不均勻；提高取樣率仍需足夠感測頻寬與抗混疊處理，不能只增加資料列數。解釋前先固定模型適用範圍：等速與等時間取樣的間距，不代表可以解析同樣大小的最小缺陷。~Fixed-rate sampling spreads observations farther apart at higher inspection speed and may miss short wavelengths. Check timestamps and anti-alias assumptions rather than treating extra data rows as stronger geometry evidence. Time sampling in a moving system corresponds to spatial spacing; at higher speed, the same rate can miss narrow features. Timestamp jitter makes spatial samples nonuniform. A higher rate still requires adequate sensor bandwidth and anti-alias filtering, rather than merely more rows of data. Before interpreting the result, fix its domain: Spacing for constant speed and uniform sampling; it is not automatically the smallest resolvable defect size.
units.model: 原創假想教學輸入：移動速度 v=25 m/s；取樣頻率 f=20 Hz。公式 y=v/f，代入得 y=1.25 m/sample。邊界：等速與等時間取樣的間距，不代表可以解析同樣大小的最小缺陷。~Original hypothetical teaching inputs: motion speed v=25 m/s; sampling frequency f=20 Hz. units.anchor: 理想吸力模型的適用邊界~Limits of an ideal magnetic-attraction model
units.title: 理想吸力模型的適用邊界~Limits of an ideal magnetic-attraction model
units.mechanism: 只用理想均勻氣隙的靜態磁壓說明磁通平方的尺度關係，不把它冒充超導電動懸浮。再指出導梁間隙誤差會透過不同磁路機制影響力，需依實際系統另建模型。簡化氣隙磁壓與磁通密度平方成正比，幾何間隙與磁路會影響可達磁通。電磁吸引與電動懸浮的機制不同，不能把這個靜態吸力式套到所有磁浮；線圈控制、飽和與動態穩定性仍需要獨立模型。解釋前先固定模型適用範圍：均勻理想氣隙的靜態磁壓，不是超導電動懸浮系統的完整力模型。~Use ideal uniform-gap static pressure only to illustrate square-flux scaling, not superconducting electrodynamic suspension. Explain that gap errors affect force through system-specific magnetic mechanisms requiring separate models. Simplified air-gap magnetic pressure scales with flux density squared, while gap geometry and magnetic circuit govern attainable flux. Electromagnetic attraction differs from electrodynamic suspension, so this static expression does not apply to every maglev. Control, saturation and dynamic stability need separate models. Before interpreting the result, fix its domain: Static magnetic pressure in an ideal uniform air gap, not a complete superconducting electrodynamic-suspension force model.
units.model: 原創假想教學輸入：代表磁通密度 B=0.6 T；作用面積 A=0.02 m2；真空導磁率 mu0=1.25664e-06 H/m。公式 y=B*B*A/(2*mu0)/1000，代入得 y=2.86479 kN。邊界：均勻理想氣隙的靜態磁壓，不是超導電動懸浮系統的完整力模型。~Original hypothetical teaching inputs: representative flux density B=0.6 T; active area A=0.02 m2; vacuum permeability mu0=1.25664e-06 H/m. Retain uncertain observations rather than discarding adverse evidence to force the expected conclusion.

Recalculate 2.86479 to 3.46639 kN. units.anchor: 幾何與車體量測時間鏈~Timing of geometry and vehicle measurements
units.title: 幾何與車體量測時間鏈~Timing of geometry and vehicle measurements
units.mechanism: 比較導梁位置資料和車體加速度時，先確認兩者使用同一時間基準。校時偏移會把反應配到錯誤位置，因此需在推論幾何原因前核對事件對齊。時鐘頻率偏差會隨時間累積成時間差，校時瞬間的偏移與之不同。多系統事件排序若依不同時鐘，可能把因果順序顛倒；校時跳變又會使量測區間長度失真，所以需記錄時鐘品質與校正事件。解釋前先固定模型適用範圍：固定頻率偏差的線性累積，忽略溫度漂移與校時伺服動態。~Confirm a common timebase before comparing guideway position data with vehicle acceleration. Clock offsets can associate a response with the wrong location, so alignment precedes geometric causal claims. Clock frequency error accumulates into time offset and differs from initial synchronization offset. Ordering multisystem events on different clocks can reverse apparent causality. Synchronization jumps can distort interval lengths, so clock quality and correction events must be recorded. Before interpreting the result, fix its domain: Linear accumulation at fixed frequency offset; temperature drift and synchronization-servo dynamics are omitted.

Recalculate 0.072 to 0.0792 s. units.anchor: 測量施工與運行邊界~Survey, construction and running cases
units.title: 測量施工與運行邊界~Survey, construction and running cases
units.mechanism: 把梁段製作、安裝定位和運行量測分成不同證據層，不能以其中一層合格替代全部。建立速度、溫度與支承條件的案例矩陣，保留未驗證的動態耦合。測試覆蓋率只對已定義的分母有意義。需求、狀態、轉移與危害各有不同分母，執行很多正常案例仍可能漏掉罕見但重要的交接；同一案例重跑多次不會自動增加獨立需求的覆蓋。解釋前先固定模型適用範圍：計數式已知案例覆蓋，不是失效機率或安全完整性量化。~Separate fabrication, erection and running evidence rather than allowing one successful layer to stand for all. Build speed, temperature and support cases while retaining unverified dynamic coupling. Coverage is meaningful only relative to its defined denominator. Requirements, states, transitions and hazards have different denominators. Many normal cases can still omit a rare but important handoff, and repeating one case does not automatically cover additional independent requirements. Before interpreting the result, fix its domain: Count-based coverage of known cases, not a probability of failure or a safety-integrity measure.
units.model: 原創假想教學輸入：已執行案例 tested=72 cases；已定義案例 total=90 cases。公式 y=tested/total，代入得 y=0.8 1。邊界：計數式已知案例覆蓋，不是失效機率或安全完整性量化。~Original hypothetical teaching inputs: executed cases tested=72 cases; defined cases total=90 cases. Formula y=tested/total gives y=0.8 1. Boundary: Count-based coverage of known cases, not a probability of failure or a safety-integrity measure.

units.anchor: 有限合格紀錄的外推~Extrapolating finite successful records
units.title: 有限合格紀錄的外推~Extrapolating finite successful records
units.mechanism: 連續相鄰測點往往相關，全部合格不能直接當成大量獨立零失效試驗。先定義抽樣母體與獨立單位，再解讀上界並限制對未測梁段的外推。零次觀察到失效不代表真實失效機率為零。獨立伯努利試驗可由全數成功的機率反推單側上界，試驗數增加才會縮小界限；相關測試或只選容易案例會使這個統計推論不再成立，也不能由此宣告達到安全完整性等級。解釋前先固定模型適用範圍：獨立同分布二元試驗且觀察零失效，非每小時失效率。~Adjacent measurements are often correlated and cannot become many independent failure-free trials merely by passing. Define the population and independent units before interpreting a bound or extrapolating to unmeasured sections. Zero observed failures does not imply zero true failure probability. Independent Bernoulli trials allow a one-sided upper bound from the probability of all successes, which decreases with sample count. Correlated or selectively easy cases invalidate this inference and cannot establish a safety-integrity level. Before interpreting the result, fix its domain: Independent identical binary trials with zero observed failures, not an hourly failure rate.
units.model: 原創假想教學輸入：獨立試驗次數 tests=300 independent trials；單側信賴水準 confidence=0.95 1。公式 y=1-(1-confidence)**(1/tests)，代入得 y=0.00993608 failure probability。邊界：獨立同分布二元試驗且觀察零失效，非每小時失效率。~Original hypothetical teaching inputs: independent trial count tests=300 independent trials; one-sided confidence level confidence=0.95 1. Formula y=1-(1-confidence)**(1/tests) gives y=0.00993608 failure probability. Boundary: Independent identical binary trials with zero observed failures, not an hourly failure rate.

Retain uncertain observations rather than discarding adverse evidence to force the expected conclusion.
units.misconception: 完成很多次沒有故障的測試就能證明故障機率為零~Many failure-free tests prove that the failure probability is zero.
units.practice: 只把獨立試驗次數 tests 從 300 改成 301 independent trials（增加一個可計數單位），其餘輸入固定。重算結果應由 0.00993608 變為 0.00990324 failure probability。先說明「有限合格紀錄的外推」中變化的因果方向，再檢查適用邊界是否仍成立，提交計算與一個可反駁此解釋的觀測。~Change only independent trial count tests from 300 to 301 independent trials (increase by one whole count), holding other inputs fixed. Recalculate 0.00993608 to 0.00990324 failure probability. Explain the causal direction for extrapolating finite successful records, check that the stated boundary still holds, and submit the calculation plus one observation that could refute the explanation.

facts: 教學假設：導向道測量角度誤差採 distance=40 m；本課公式結果 1 mm，非現場額定值。~Teaching assumption for angular error in guideway surveying: distance=40 m; this model gives 1 mm, not a field rating.
教學假設：精度帳的獨立與相關成分採 s1=3 mm；本課公式結果 5 mm，非現場額定值。~Teaching assumption for independent and correlated precision terms: s1=3 mm; this model gives 5 mm, not a field rating.
教學假設：導梁溫差與基準時刻採 L=30 m；本課公式結果 7.2 mm，非現場額定值。~Teaching assumption for guideway temperature and reference epoch: L=30 m; this model gives 7.2 mm, not a field rating.
教學假設：不平順波長轉換採 speed=40 m/s；本課公式結果 2 Hz，非現場額定值。~Teaching assumption for converting irregularity wavelengths: speed=40 m/s; this model gives 2 Hz, not a field rating.
教學假設：懸浮系統頻率量級採 k=1.8e+06 N/m；本課公式結果 1.94924 Hz，非現場額定值。~Teaching assumption for frequency scale of a suspension model: k=1.8e+06 N/m; this model gives 1.94924 Hz, not a field rating.
教學假設：幾何檢測速度與取樣採 v=25 m/s；本課公式結果 1.25 m/sample，非現場額定值。~Teaching assumption for inspection speed and geometric sampling: v=25 m/s; this model gives 1.25 m/sample, not a field rating.
